finding: Owner authority at epoch 8.69 legitimately re-admits only the available free contingents/free tokens for Groq, Mistral, NVIDIA and OpenRouter, superseding the prior runtime quarantine for future admitted traffic while preserving all pre-admission traffic as append-only unadmitted history. Official provider documentation confirms that free access exists for these providers, but provider-level identity alone is too coarse to prove that a concrete credential/model/route invocation is zero-cost because Groq and Mistral also expose paid tiers and OpenRouter exposes both free and paid routes. The running 6000-worker fabric currently gates on provider-level cost_class=FREE and credential presence; therefore FREE_ONLY requires credential/route-level economic binding before provider runtime credit or unrestricted lane scaling.
required_next_cycle: Do not roll back the owner's epoch-8.69 authorization of free contingents. Instead narrow FREE_ONLY admission from provider identity to the concrete credential plus model/route plus current free-entitlement evidence actually used for each request.

Add FREE_LANE_EXECUTION_RECEIPT/v1 at the shared provider-call boundary. It must bind provider, credential fingerprint, account/tier or entitlement evidence when observable, exact model/route, admission epoch/digest, request id, usage tokens, HTTP status, and a zero-cost/free-route assertion derived from provider-side evidence rather than model consensus.

For OpenRouter, allow only routes whose current provider-side pricing is zero, such as explicit free variants/free router; a generic OpenRouter key must never authorize paid routes. For Groq/Mistral, a provider name plus key is insufficient if the account can be paid; bind observable Free-tier plan/limits or fail closed for autonomous FREE_ONLY execution. For NVIDIA, bind Developer-Program/free NIM entitlement or equivalent provider-side free-access evidence.
HTTP 402 remains a hard stop but is not a sufficient economic safety mechanism: a paid-tier credential can accrue charges without first returning 402.
Preserve all pre-owner-admission and pre-route-binding provider calls as historical evidence with their original admission status; do not relabel them FREE post hoc.
Keep Together and every PAID/SUBSCRIPTION/UNKNOWN route forbidden. No paid fallback, upgrade, credit purchase, or billing activation is authorized.
Do not mint Whole-EntityOS, Whole-HCU, BASE, canonical-semantics, provider-quality or independent Goodman credit from token volume, model agreement, logical-worker count or provider success alone.

Treat the current efficiency funnel as a blocker for scaling quality claims: 3.24M measured swarm tokens currently yield 1 machine-readable delta, 0 forge-accepted deltas and 0 accepted distillery dataset tokens. Optimize conversion to executable/reproduced deltas before interpreting higher logical-worker counts as progress.

FREE_LANE_EXECUTION_RECEIPT/v1.pass_condition: The exact request is executable evidence for use of an owner-authorized free contingent with paid_fallback_attempt_count=0. Provider-level FREE labels alone do not satisfy this receipt.
